item.title: London native plans to row 5,000 km across the Atlantic Ocean – solo
item.description: A London-raised rower is gearing up for a massive journey across the Atlantic Ocean, competing in a grueling race in support of two charities and hoping to raise $250,000.

item.title: Waterford resident charged with impaired driving after Brant OPP spot car in ditch
item.description: A driver has been charged with being impaired after Brant OPP officers noticed a vehicle in a ditch on Jan. 22. Police were on patrol when they saw the vehicle in a ditch on Pleasant Ridge Road near Ellis Avenue at about 11:40 p.m. Police say the driver refused the officer’s breath demand into an approved alcohol screening device.
